# tether

> Tether is a small, headless-first harness that lets small local models and frontier models do real work with a tiny prompt: one `act(cmd, stdin)` tool, commands off by default, SQLite for state and memory, a deterministic sandbox and verification gates. Python 3.12+, `pip install tether-sdk`, command `tether`.

## Start here
- [Home](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/): what tether is, install, first run.
- [Fix a failing test with a local model](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/guides/fix-a-failing-test/): a verification gate decides when the job is done.
- [Use tether from Claude Code, Codex or Cursor](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/guides/use-tether-from-your-agent/): MCP setup, the JSON result, exit codes.
- [A pipeline where each stage has its own job](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/guides/a-pipeline-with-checks/): stages, per-stage model, tools and gate.
- [Give the model a tool of your own](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/guides/add-your-own-tool/): turn a Python function into a command.

## Guides
- [Guides index](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/tutorial/): every layer, from the first session to multi-agent workflows.
- [CLI and headless sessions](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/tutorial/cli-and-headless/): run, watch, resume and read back sessions.
- [Python SDK and custom tools](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/tutorial/sdk-and-custom-tools/): Harness, @tool, stdin payloads.
- [Built-in tools](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/tutorial/built-in-tools/): done, bash, edit, web, mem, skill, agent.
- [Progressive skills](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/tutorial/skills/): package a repeatable job.
- [Async multi-agent orchestration](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/tutorial/multi-agent/): spawn, wait, query sub-agents.
- [Gates, memory, pipelines and telemetry](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/tutorial/workflows-and-telemetry/): verification gates, pipelines, tether stats.
- [Security and sandbox](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/tutorial/security-and-sandbox/): what a session can touch.
- [Use tether inside your harness](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/tutorial/agent-interface/): MCP and CLI twins for other agents.
- [Extending tether](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/extending/): add tools and model backends.

## Concepts
- [Architecture and literature](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/architecture/): why it works this way.

- [Coding Ladder](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/ladder/): tether's own coding benchmark, 24 tasks in 6 tiers, and how to run it.
- [Coding Ladder results](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/ladder/results/): where qwen3.5:9b, qwen3.5:4b and qwen2.5-coder:7b stop, tether against a bare tool loop, and what to expect.
- [Glossary](https://igormcsouza.github.io/tether/glossary/): the terms used across the docs.
